caption: The drawing depicts a stylized green vase with a light teal hue and curved handles sitting on a neutral beige or taupe background. From the vase emerges a large bouquet of broad green leaves, some accented with darker shades and black outlines. Interspersed among the leaves are flower-like shapes that have red and pink bases, with green and teal petals and black centers. The stems curve outward and downward, some looping in fluid arcs, while thin, black lines suggest additional stems or tendrils. On the left and right vertical edges of the composition, similar flowers and leaves appear in a repeated, vertical bordering pattern, each with green, teal, pink, and red coloring. These border elements frame the central vase and bouquet, with additional individual flowers in the upper right and lower left corners, echoing the color scheme and style of the larger arrangement.
title: Hand Painted Wall
